marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Dr. Nieca Goldberg’s complete guide to women’s health

If you’re a woman over thirty-five you probably have a lot of stress in your life--maybe even more than you realize. You’re most likely low on energy, gaining weight, and not sleeping as well as you once did. The fact is: your body is changing. You see and feel it happening, but you don’t know any more what is normal and what is not. And if you’re like most women, you don’t think your health care providers are giving you the help you need. In fact, traditional doctors may not even be aware of many diseases that present special problems in women. Dr. Goldberg knows what you’re going through. Here she gives you a personal consultation so that you can understand the changes in your body, solve problems that plague women starting in their mid-thirties, and find the right doctor for optimal health care.--From publisher description
